body:
D2 READ-ONLY AUDIT — AMEND, NOT BLOCK. I audited exact plan b12f79ceb61e020cd02c43c631ed015a9034d9c3b9c597da726337425a21e748, ADR 0007, and the current portable source surface. The one-primary-axis rule, PTS/DTS separation, explicit VFR index, three mapping families, occurrence identity, and nonfunctional reverse are correct. No code implementation exists yet, so the findings below are contract gaps and proposed courts, not runtime defects.

PRIMARY-SOURCE CHECK. FFmpeg defines packet PTS and DTS in stream time-base units and permits either to be AV_NOPTS_VALUE; packet duration 0 means unknown, not a measured zero-length interval. AVStream separately exposes start_time and pts_wrap_bits. Its rescale API requires an explicit rounding mode; nearest rescaling is not exact conversion. Sources: https://ffmpeg.org/doxygen/trunk/structAVPacket.html, https://ffmpeg.org/doxygen/trunk/structAVStream.html, https://ffmpeg.org/doxygen/trunk/group__lavu__math.html.

1. MISSINGNESS AND CLOCK EPOCH MUST BE STRUCTURAL. Plan 3.1 currently says native timestamps are integers. That is insufficient at the ingest boundary. A coordinate must distinguish present signed ticks from missing PTS/DTS; AV_NOPTS_VALUE must never enter as Long.MinValue wearing a coordinate type. Likewise duration must distinguish KnownPositive from Unknown; container duration 0 must not construct an empty interval or an instant. Negative PTS and nonzero origins are lawful. Raw counters also need an epoch/unwrap identity: after wrap, reset, splice, or discontinuity, equal raw ticks are different occurrences. Clock repair may be monotone within each epoch; it cannot call a resetting raw counter one monotone clock before splitting it.

COURTS: replace MissingPTS with Long.MinValue and watch admission fail; map duration 0 to [pts,pts) and watch unknown-duration refusal fail; admit negative PTS plus a nonzero origin; create two occurrences with the same raw tick on opposite sides of a wrap/reset and prove dropping epoch identity collapses them. The F0 manifest should retain wrap width and unwrap/discontinuity receipt when the container exposes them.

2. EXACT RATIONAL DOES NOT YET SAY WHAT HAPPENS ON AN INTEGRAL TARGET LATTICE. A source tick under one rational timebase often maps between target ticks. The contract must either keep the projected coordinate rational or return a typed quantized/enclosing result with rounding policy and residual/error bound. It must never round and then publish the target integer as exact. Intermediate multiplication must be overflow-safe or refuse; a mathematically in-range quotient can overflow a Long multiply first.

COURTS: 1 tick at timebase 1/3 projected to milliseconds must not become exact tick 333; two distinct rationals that round to 333 ms must remain distinguishable; a large signed tick whose naive ticks*num overflows must equal an independent arbitrary-precision oracle or refuse. Start/end rounding for half-open intervals must be declared and must not invent coverage.

3. TOLERANCE IS NOT COORDINATE EQUALITY. The plan correctly binds tolerance into a mapping receipt, but the word is underspecified. Tolerance should be an admission/residual bound for a fitted relation, separate from localization uncertainty. It must not define fuzzy equality, deduplication, interval membership, or axis identity: abs(a-b) <= tol is nontransitive. Accepted mappings retain exact segments plus observed residual/support; a tolerance change may alter admission but cannot make two distinct ticks identical.

COURT: choose a,b,c where a~b and b~c under tolerance but a!~c; any equality/dedup implementation must fail. Mutating exact endpoint comparison to tolerance comparison must also fail interval ordering and canonicalization laws.

4. THE PRESENTATION AXIS SHOULD BE THE EDITION PLAYBACK TIMELINE, NOT AN ELEMENTARY STREAM CLOCK. The table phrase primary presentation stream can still be read as making picture-stream PTS the axis. Edit lists, empty edits, holds, audio pre/post-roll, and selected renditions show why the audience-facing edition timeline is the primary identity; each native picture/audio/subtitle stream composes onto it. A picture gap is not absence of edition time. Designating the authority stream is useful ingest provenance, but the axis must survive intervals where that stream has no sample.

COURT: an edition interval with no picture sample but continuing admitted audio remains a lawful presentation interval; replacing the edition axis with picture-native PTS makes it disappear and must fail. Unknown final-frame duration must not be extended to edition end merely to fill the axis.

5. SEPARATE MAPPING MEANING FROM DERIVATION RECEIPT. The plan currently puts algorithm, parameters, and input checksums in the mapping checksum and also makes alignment receipts participate in source-view identity. That risks making two byte-identical checked relations incomparable because one algorithm split an affine segment into two or used another parser version. Keep distinct identities for axis, canonical mapping relation/geometry, and derivation receipt. Compatibility and coordinate arithmetic depend on axes plus canonical relation; audit/build identity retains the receipt and selected rendition. Semantically equivalent adjacent-segment coalescing must preserve relation identity while provenance may differ. This is the same provider-fingerprint versus geometry distinction already used by embed-core.

COURT: one affine segment versus two adjacent equal-slope segments denotes the same relation; changing only segmentation or deriving algorithm must not change relation identity, while the receipt remains distinguishable. Conversely changing a gap, occurrence, slope, intercept, or endpoint must change relation identity.

6. ROUND-TRIP LAWS MUST BE CONDITIONAL, NOT GLOBAL. Exact reverse(project(p)) == p is lawful only on an exact bijective segment. Holds, repeated ranges, reordering, quantization, and edition correspondence do not have a functional inverse. Reverse projection must return every occurrence-scoped preimage, a bounded preimage interval/set, or Ambiguous; never first-match. Composition may not bridge a gap merely because endpoints on either side map.

COURTS: exact affine bijection round-trips; a hold returns a preimage extent rather than one invented point; a repeated source interval returns both occurrence-scoped targets; reversing their targets does not discard either occurrence; gap through A->B->C stays a gap; equal normalized values across editions still refuse. Removing occurrence from equality or replacing reverse results with head must kill a named assertion.

VERDICT: ACCEPT the architecture and AMEND plan sections 3.1, 3.2, 10.1, and 10.3 with these distinctions before C1 public vocabulary is designed. I do not propose names as settled API and made no file edit. WHAT I DID NOT DO: inspect real media bytes, run ffprobe on an admitted fixture, validate a container edit list, or prove any current Scala defect. Those are F0 implementation measurements after B0/P1 authorization, not evidence this read-only audit can honestly claim.
